edges.source: Sri Vaishnava & South Indian Vaishnava Traditions
edges.rationale: Introduce southern Vaishnava and Shaiva sacred landscapes side by side without collapsing their philosophies.
Arunachala provides a Tamil/Shaiva sacred-landscape connection; Ramana’s Advaita identity remains distinct.
Move from a named contemplative centre into neighbouring southern avadhuta/Advaita contexts. No universal guru chain is asserted.
Priority boundary: southern Datta/avadhuta contexts meet western Datta displays. Narasimha Saraswati’s Karnataka/Maharashtra landscape provides a named story. Keep independent families distinct.
edges.priorityMeaning: Recommended cross-region physical adjacency; not a stronger evidence rating or a common lineage for every saint.

edges.rationale: Continue into Maharashtra’s connected guru settings; use only reviewed named relationships, not an all-saints Datta umbrella.
Move from guru-centred networks into Pandharpur/Vitthal devotional communities while retaining their separate groupings.
Dnyaneshwar/Nivrittinath’s Nath context offers a specific bridge toward Nath material; no claim that all Varkaris are Nath or directly connected to all Girnar saints.
Finish the western route in Gujarat’s institutional/devotional landscape. This is geography and visitor flow, not a single lineage.

edges.target: Sri Vaishnava & South Indian Vaishnava Traditions

Lahiri Mahasaya and Yukteswar/Yogananda link Kashi and Bengal within the named Kriya lineage. Keep the reviewed family together and use cross-references for its other life locations.

scope: Interpretive relationship and layout exploration only; no identity, parent, family or physical placement changes. Lines are not exhaustive and carry no distance, chronology or strength scale.

interaction.focusMode: Optional; isolate links incident to the selected subsection
interaction.lineClick: Anchored non-modal pop-up beside the clicked line, constrained to visible space; no filtering, scrolling or subsection selection changes. Close button, Escape and outside click dismiss.
interaction.layout: Deterministic spring layout with soft regional clustering and rectangle collision avoidance; all edges have equal influence. Layout is interpretive, not historical evidence or physical assignments.
